implementations.rationale: Smallest complete instance of the pattern: marker annotation whose @ExtendWith meta-annotation self-registers the resolving extension.
Configurable variant: annotation members carry filter, cardinality, timeout with defaults.
The reusable core: implements all five JUnit5 lifecycle interfaces once; subclasses only provide annotation type, target types, resolveValue().
Minimal concrete subclass: constructor wires annotation + target type; resolveValue delegates to store accessor.
Full lifecycle: lazy store creation keyed to unique test id, CloseableResource wrapper, parent-context walk for nested classes, proxy-based cleanup.
Complete integration-test launch descriptor: junit-platform tester, Equinox framework, single identity requirement, resolver-computed runbundles.
implementations.excerpt:
-tester: biz.aQute.tester.junit-platform

-runvm: -enableassertions:org.osgi.test...,\
	${def;argLine}

-runfw: org.eclipse.osgi
-resolve.effective: active
-runproperties: \
	logback.configurationFile='${fileuri;${.}/logback.xml}',\
	org.osgi.framework.bootdelegation='sun.misc,sun.reflect',\
	osgi.console=

-runpath: \
	ch.qos.logback.classic,\
	ch.qos.logback.core,\
	org.apache.felix.logback,\
	slf4j.api
-runrequires: \
	bnd.identity;id='${project.artifactId}-tests'
# This will help us keep -runbundles sorted
-runstartlevel: \
    order=sortbynameversion,\
    begin=-1
# -runbundles is calculated by the bnd-resolver-maven-plugin

implementations.rationale: bnd-workspace variant: Test-Cases discovery macro via JUnit platform @Testable hierarchy scan.
implementations.excerpt:
-include: ${workspace}/cnf/includes/jdt.bnd

Bundle-Description: OSGi Testing Example Player Test

Test-Cases: ${classes;HIERARCHY_INDIRECTLY_ANNOTATED;org.junit.platform.commons.annotation.Testable;CONCRETE}

-dependson: \
	org.osgi.test.example.player.impl

-buildpath: \
	osgi.core;version=8.0.0;maven-scope=provided,\
	org.osgi.namespace.service;version=1.0.0;maven-scope=provided,\
	org.osgi.test.example.api;version=snapshot,\
	${junit},\
	${mockito},\
	${osgitest}

implementations.rationale: Canonical AssertJ leaf class: extends Abstract variant, static assertThat factory, InstanceOfAssertFactory constant for asInstanceOf chaining.
Complete consumer-side test: static + instance injection, service registration in @BeforeAll, ServiceAware for dynamic arrival, DictionaryAssert usage.
